conclusion: Stronger fixed kickoff-origin match result does not establish broad gameplay: keep original shooting/ongoing-start outcomes separate. No runtime or learner change.

summary.no_touch_semantics: Zero by protocol; use matches_without_rival_touch, not reset count

skills.meaning: Each fixed skill case ends at its first native goal or time limit. Natural includes kickoff AND ongoing ground; do not call aggregate kickoff gains general ground play.

timings.meaning: Time between native goal events, with up to three ticks reset-boundary rounding. Entry height does not identify aerial control, shot intent or last touch.
